name_zh: 格陵兰·库普·克努森：自治渔业与稀土气候独立博弈
name_en: Greenland Kuupik Kleist: Autonomy Fisheries & Rare Earth Climate Independence Game
description_zh: 库普·克努森 (1958-) 格陵兰自治政府总理 (2009-2013)，推动自治法案扩大立法权，渔业主导经济寻求稀土矿产多元化，气候变化冰盖融化开辟航道资源竞争，与丹麦博弈独立时间表。
description_en: Kuupik Kleist (1958-) Greenland Self-Government PM (2009-2013), promoted Self-Government Act expanding legislative powers, fisheries dominant economy seeking rare earth diversification, climate change ice melt opening shipping lanes resource competition, negotiating independence timeline with Denmark.
reason_zh: 克努森代表北极原住民如何通过自治法律框架与资源主权争取独立主体性，展示了气候变化如何同时成为生存威胁与资源机遇双重悖论，其独立博弈重塑北极地缘政治版图。
reason_en: Kleist represents how Arctic indigenous people pursue independent subjectivity through autonomy legal framework and resource sovereignty, demonstrating how climate change becomes both existential threat and resource opportunity paradox, his independence game reshaping Arctic geopolitical map.
steps_zh: 研究克努森早年哥本哈根教育与因纽特文化根基
分析2009年自治法案通过与立法司法权扩大
探讨渔业垄断经济与稀土矿产/铀矿开发争议
评估气候融冰开辟西北航道与美中俄北极博弈
总结自治渔业稀土气候冰盖独立丹麦博弈对北极原住民主权的前沿探索
steps_en: Study Kleist early Copenhagen education and Inuit cultural roots
Analyze 2009 Self-Government Act passage and legislative judicial powers expansion
Explore fisheries monopoly economy and rare earth/uranium mining controversy
Evaluate climate melt opening Northwest Passage and US-China-Russia Arctic game
Summarize autonomy fisheries rare earth climate ice independence Denmark game frontier exploration for Arctic indigenous sovereignty
expected_zh: 理解自治法律框架如何为原住民独立提供制度路径，掌握气候变化作为生存威胁与资源机遇双重悖论的北极特殊性，评估格陵兰模式对努纳武特萨米等北极原住民自治的示范。
expected_en: Understand how autonomy legal framework provides institutional path for indigenous independence, grasp climate change as existential threat and resource opportunity dual paradox Arctic specificity, evaluate Greenland model demonstration for Nunavut Sami Arctic indigenous autonomy.
case_zh: 2009 自治法案；2013 卸任；稀土/气候/独立。自治渔业稀土气候独立范式永存。
case_en: 2009 Self-Government Act; 2013 retirement; rare earth/climate/independence. Autonomy fisheries rare earth climate independence paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Inuit Self-Determination / Arctic Resource Sovereignty / Climate Justice
cross_cultural_impact: Greenland autonomy; rare earth; climate change; Arctic geopolitics; indigenous sovereignty
